provenance.reading_guide: relabel row = engine's relabel frame (court-stamped copy; on this 6-action/5-bit model that frame resolves to the generalized judge -- six actions cannot be indexed as bit flips of a 5-bit state -- which derives the action renaming from the state permutation, coinciding with the forced per-element ordered-pair maps, so the column passes in step with the explicit receipts); fixed row = ordered pairs pinned (--strict); the explicit declarations of g1/g3 are adjudicated by the vendored engine directly (receipts in receipts/) and by the compare subcommand's declared-caliber gate arm; networkx columns = independent juror (at 32 states the automorphism-set cross-check runs under the court's scale guard, and the O(E) direct edge-set check remains the primary)

g1_swap_ab_map.claim: defendant A: swapping rods A and B and renaming the ordered-pair actions with the rods ('the move A->B' becomes 'the move B->A', every pair renamed (X,Y) -> (piX,piY)) preserves the puzzle exactly -- ordered pairs are bound to rod identity, so the true symmetry carries its own action renaming; declared under the explicit caliber with per-element action maps

relabel.note: court-stamped relabel frame resolves to the generalized judge on this 6-action/5-bit model (six actions cannot be indexed as bit flips of a 5-bit state, so no bitstring reading arises); the generalized judge derives the action renaming from the state permutation itself, which coincides with the forced per-element ordered-pair maps, so the column passes in step with the explicit receipts (contrast mini2048/sliding2x3, where the same frame resolves to the bitstring judge and rejects as a diagnostic)

g1_swap_ab_map.note: the explicit declaration is adjudicated by the vendored engine directly (receipts/check.g1_swap_ab_map.json, engine run without --strict: pass, worst_tv 0.0, homomorphism_checked full) and by the compare subcommand's declared-caliber gate arm; the relabel column here resolves to the generalized judge, which derives the action renaming from the state permutation itself -- on this model that derivation coincides with the forced per-element ordered-pair maps, so the column passes in step with the explicit receipts (contrast mini2048/sliding2x3, where the same frame resolves to the bitstring judge and rejects as a diagnostic; contrast lightsout3, where 9 actions = 9 bits made the bitstring derivation coincide with the per-element button maps); the fixed column is the pairs-pinned contrast
